RPSelectionRule.WP: Explicit selection; LK at least two WP framework blocks with at least30hours, GK at least one with at least9hours
RPSelectionRule.W: Unselected WP becomes W; selected W need not cover every item but must have sufficient breadth/depth and convey essentials. It is not permission to discard chosen duties.
RPSelectionRule.selectedRP62LK: Fundamentum classification plus Additum azo synthesis mechanism and at least two further classes; other classes do not require mechanisms.
RPSelectionRule.selectedGKFundamentum: Separate source duty; the proposed LK goal with minimum-two-additional-class Additum does not certify it.

SNSelectionRule.wholePrimaryPreface: An additional elective learning area of two weeks may be addressed; actual selection is not established by LK/year alone.
SNSelectionRule.selectedWB1: Goals/content of the chosen learning area retain their operator demands; remarks are recommendations. The classification view is only one bounded duty, not the whole WB1 including experiments.
